data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2021 were GBP 87.793m. The gross claims development triangle indicates a net favourable prior year development of approximately GBP 4.633m (a ~5.3% release of opening gross reserves), driven by releases observed in the 2018 and 2019 underwriting years. The notes report a net favourable prior year development of GBP 5.1m (net of reinsurance). Current-year catastrophe activity (Hurricane Ida, European floods and US Winter Storms) affected 2021 performance but the prior-year movements were favourable overall.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross reserves sourced from Statement of Financial Position (claims outstanding). Prior year development gross figure calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross triangle presented in GBP 000) by excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2021, 2020) and summing diagonal changes for 2018 and 2019. The explicit prior year development sentence in the notes reports a NET GBP 5.1m favourable movement; the triangle yields a GROSS release of ~GBP 4.633m. The line-by-line PYD table shown in the note appears to be presented net of reinsurance, so gross PYD by LOB is not directly available in the notes.
